facts.fact: Match 0x1b660 runs at game over unless adj 30 MATCH PERCENTAGE = 11 (off) or tournament mode (0x252a0(1))
The number is drawn FIRST, always: m = random(10) * 10 (call at 0x1b6ac) -> 00, 10, ..., 90
rate = audit 0xf (TOTAL MATCHES) * 100 / audit 0x11 (GAMES STARTED), read via 0x164c(id, 0xc0); rate = 0 if no games
If rate < adj 30: every player p (1..players) whose score % 100 == m wins: bit p set in a mask (-> deff +0x30) and the winner count 0x3743e increments

Else (rate >= adj 30): forced loss - m steps +10 (99 -> 0) and is re-checked against all players until nobody matches; it ALWAYS moves at least once, so the shown number is never the drawn one; error log 0xb1 if it cycles back

Per player the natural chance is 1/10 when rate < adj 30 and 0 otherwise, so the lifetime match rate settles just under adj 30 percent (factory 9 %) per game; a score's last two digits are always x0 in this game (all awards are multiples of 10)

deff 38 gets the winner mask (+0x30) and the number (+0x34); music 0x01c at start, sfx 0x041, 0x03f, 0x040, 0x042 (identical in win and loss); a win adds 0x043 when the award is given and 0x045 1.6 s later

After the deff, per winner every 31 ticks (0x1b954 -> match_award 0x1b86c): adj 29 MATCH AWARD 0 -> credit 0x4cf0(0x36f66) + knocker 0x1b370(1,1) (sound 0x019); 1 -> ticket 0x100f8; 2 -> nothing. Audit 0xf
deff 38 lasts 6.24 s on a loss and 7.84 s on a win, then attract deff 1

Forcing in the emulator: pokeat 1b6ac 372c4 SEED 4 writes the seed just before random(10). SEED = (next - 1) * inverse(0x19660d) mod 2^32 with next in [d * 2^32 / 10, (d + 1) * 2^32 / 10) for the wanted digit d. d = 4 -> SEED 0xa7bf957a (next 0x73333333)
